name: SmartMeet.ai
desc: AI-powered real-time video conferencing platform built with Spring Boot, React, WebRTC, and STOMP/WebSocket. Features low-latency audio/video, screen sharing, meeting scheduling, host moderation, JWT + OAuth2 authentication, and AI-driven focus and sentiment analytics.

name: Task Management System API
desc: RESTful Task Management API engineered with Java, Spring Boot, and MySQL. Features full CRUD operations, pagination, input validation, role-based access control (USER/ADMIN), JWT, Google OAuth2, and Refresh Tokens with complete Swagger/OpenAPI documentation and JUnit 5/Mockito test coverage.

name: TripNest (Infosys Springboard)
desc: Full-stack travel planning platform developed using Java, Spring Boot, React.js, and MySQL. Implemented 20+ secure RESTful API endpoints for trip, itinerary, expense, collaboration, and user modules with AI-assisted recommendations and automated trip notes.
